original_flag: NVDA differed between two sequential reads of an actively updating cache
diagnosis: The audit read the dashboard cache and chart selector in separate SQLite transactions. A supplier update could arrive between them, so the flag did not establish an inconsistency within one cache version.
correction: Read both selection rules in one SQLite read transaction without changing stored quotes.
corrected_result: Six of six compared price, session and source-time tuples matched in the same snapshot.
software_check: 10 focused tests passed after the audit correction
